metric.why: When interconnection queues stretch to years, on-site generation is the bypass: it trades grid-queue time for fuel logistics, permitting, and backup-capacity obligations. The rise of behind-the-meter builds is a direct gauge of how binding the grid constraint has become.
metric.target: Disclosed in permits, air-quality filings, and operator announcements rather than any central registry.
metric.definition: Dedicated on-site power, gas turbines, microgrids, storage, or eventually reactors, wired directly to the facility rather than drawn through a public grid connection.

siblings.label: Approval to energize versus queued load
